exact_statement: For every finite nonempty positive vector x (dimension N>=1) and coordinatewise thinning 0<y<=x, put A_x=sum x_i, D_x=prod(1+x_i)-1, Q_x(R)=prod_{i in R}x_i/D_x for nonempty R, r_x(i)=x_i/A_x and L=sum(x_i-y_i). Then -L<=ln(D_y/D_x)-ln(A_y/A_x)<=0 and |KL_nats(Q_y||Q_x)-KL_nats(r_y||r_x)|<=L. For activities x_e=lambda_e 2^-w_e, y_e=lambda_prime_e 2^-w_e from any finite nonempty signed-conjunction implicant table of a nonconstant uniform sign Boolean f, positive packing-feasible lambda and 0<lambda_prime<=lambda, q=Pr(f=-1), v=4q(1-q), k=min w_e>=1, a_w=(1-2^-w)/w and d_i=sum_{e:i in R_e}(lambda_e-lambda_prime_e)a_w_e, vL<=2(1-q)sum_i Inf_i(f)d_i<=2a_k(1-q)I(f). Thus either root remainder above, in bits and weighted by v, is bounded by 2(1-q)sum_i Inf_i(f)d_i/ln2. These are alternative component bounds, not an added budget.
